nos.title: Prepare for Plumbing Installations and Maintenance

performanceCriteria.text: Explain in detail the use of different tools, measuring and inspection devices, equipment and fittings for plumbing.
Perform cutting, deburring/filing, marking and fixing operations using a vice.
Assess the tool's material quality to ensure long-term use in demanding plumbing environments.
Check that the tool and fitting required are suitable for different pipe types and plumbing applications.
Ensure that the tool includes necessary safety features to prevent injuries during use.
Ensure that the pipes are installed correctly, with minimal short turns, correct distances and optimal use of space.
Verify that hot and cold water lines are correctly laid and insulated where necessary to prevent heat loss.
Interpret the position of the fixtures and their accessories for supply and drainage systems.
Understand the hot and cold water piping layout in the building.
Ensure correct pipe size/diameter/type is used to get the required pressure and flow rate for the water supply system.
Ensure correct usage of pipe size and fitting the pipe with correct slope to install the drainage system.
Ensure that all plumbing fixtures (sinks, toilets, showers) are positioned according to the architectural plan, with proper spacing for usability and maintenance.
Ensure that each fixture has clearly indicated connection points for water supply.
Check the drainage system for proper venting, position of traps and anti-siphonage to prevent breaking of water seals.
Collect required plumbing material - type, size and quantities based on specifications from drawings and plans.
Check if the tools and equipment are functioning properly and inform the relevant authority in case of any deviation.
Clear the area of hazardous substances, debris and waste as per organizational norms.
Store collected materials in a secure manner to ensure there is no spillage or cross-contamination.
Place signages and barricades as required to ensure safety and security of the work area, workers and visitors.
Plan tasks in agreement with others while adhering to time commitments.
Study a typical water distribution system and identify its different components.
Explain in detail the hot water and cold water distribution/circulation system.
Inspect a typical solar water heater system and demonstrate its different components with their applications.
Identify and select the fitting requirements to install the pipes.
Measure and mark dimensions for installation of the pipes and fittings based on site conditions, making allowances for final finishing.
Explain the limitations of solar water heaters in multi-floor buildings.
Cut G-I, CPVC, PERT, PEX or PPR pipes to the required length, ensuring measurements are proportionate to the fittings.
Bend and form the pipes to specified angles and offsets.
Prepare pipe ends using techniques such as reaming, deburring, levelling, filing and grinding.
Join different types of pipes using fittings and specified techniques.
Ensure the assembled pipe meets the required specifications.
Report any issues or difficulties that may arise and carry out the corrective actions.
Install the assembled pipe fittings and other water supply components.
Identify the area and route where the assembled pipes are to be installed.
Perform wall chasing, drilling and nailing on a range of building materials such as brickwork, concrete, block work, timber, etc.
Install pipes and other water supply components according to given specifications and site requirements, without damage or interference to the surrounding structures.
Finish the cut area of the wall after installing pipes and other water supply components.
Check if all the water supply system installations are properly aligned, sized, supported and installed.
Identify and rectify faults that are within the limits of expertise and authority, and escalate the others to authorized personnel.
Clear the work area and dispose, reuse or recycle leftover materials according to regulations and codes of practice.
Clean and store tools and equipment according to the manufacturer's recommendations and workplace procedures.
Identify the type of drainage piping systems and its components to be installed as appropriate for the type of building.
Use plumbing project plans to determine the location of various drainage components and the route of the water drainage piping and traps.
Calculate quantity, dimensions and type of materials required from design drawings/specifications.
Construct chambers to accommodate drainage systems.
Determine fitting requirements for installing various types of drainage pipes according to given specifications and site requirements.
Check if the area is prepared for laying the pipes for underground, above ground and overhead piping systems.
Install the various components of the drainage system such as pipes and their fittings, manholes, traps, cleanouts, catch basins, inspection chambers, soak pits, etc.
Perform fitting activities on various types of pipes such as stoneware (SW) pipes, polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pipes, etc.
Install stormwater and sub-soil drainage systems.
Install different types of pumps used in sanitary and drainage systems such as submersible water pumps and dewatering pumps (for rainwater piping).
Install pipework for water and sewage treatment plants.
Test the installations for proper functioning.
Repair faulty drainage pipes and traps.
Ensure that all inspection openings and covers are fitted according to relevant standards and job specifications.
Backfill excavated areas to secure the installation.
Put required signages at the site after the plumbing task has been completed.
Clear the work area and dispose, reuse or recycle leftover materials according to legislation, regulations, codes of practice and job specification.
Clean and store tools and equipment according to the manufacturer's recommendations and workplace procedures.
Plan the correct fixture requirement, parts and support material provided in the packing with the manufacturer's list or order form.
Select the size, type and quantity of fixture and trim for specific applications according to the given specifications.
Locate and mark the position of fixtures and fixture supports in structures.
Ensure fixtures are level and securely fastened; tighten connections without over-tightening, which can damage the fittings.
Cut the physical structures such as walls and concrete in line with the correct markings and specifications for performing internal pipe installations.
Install supports for plumbing piping using the correct tool to ensure grade, spacing and alignment.
Install fixtures as per specifications without damage to pipework and the surrounding area.
Install and secure the sensor for touchless fittings and fixtures in the slot provided.
Insert batteries for sensor-based fittings and fixtures safely and in compliance with the manufacturer's specifications.
Connect the fixture to water supply, drainage and electricity supply, ensuring proper functioning, safety and compliance with the manufacturer's specifications.
Perform installation of smart plumbing fixtures.
Perform installation of smart sensors and automated systems to monitor and control water flow, temperature and energy usage in real time.
Perform installation of dry wall modules and mounting of various plumbing fixtures.
Plumb and level the supports and fixtures installed to ensure alignment and balance.
Check if all installations are properly aligned, supported and functioning.
Identify and rectify or replace faults that are within limits of expertise and authority, and escalate the others to authorized personnel.
Clear the work area and dispose, reuse or recycle leftover materials according to regulations and codes of practice.
Hand over to the customer with full information and warranty card of products.
Hand over to the customer with full information and warranty card of products.

nos.title: Perform Troubleshooting and Maintenance for Domestic Plumbing Fixtures and Systems

performanceCriteria.text: Detect the root cause of the problem.
Detect blockages and damage in pipes, fittings and fixtures.
Detect the reason for low flow and low pressure.
Replace faulty pipe fittings and parts.
Remove air lock and blockages in the pipes that are installed.
Repair and maintain water supply tanks and valves.
Unclog drains and drain strainer baskets.
Repair broken sewer, dripping faucets and fixtures that are not working properly.
Resolve leakages, loosening and jamming of fittings.
Implement measures to reduce noise in pipes and fixtures.
Inspect and maintain septic systems on a timely basis.
Perform basic services for appliances such as water heaters, washing machines and dishwashers, etc.
Clean up spills quickly after the task has been completed.
Empty waste containers as per organizational procedures.
Discard oily rags and flammable materials as per industry practices.
Record daily logs in a specified format for activities such as maintenance and installation.
Guide customers on proper care and maintenance of plumbing systems.
Minimize water usage by using water-efficient fixtures and appliances.
Apply water leak prevention techniques.
Use low toxicity and environment friendly materials.
Maintain optimal water pressure to prevent waste and damage to the system.
Perform insulation on pipes carrying hot water to minimize energy loss and improve efficiency.
Use locally sourced materials and prefabricated components to reduce transportation energy, and choose products with a lower carbon footprint.
Ensure that the plumbing system complies with relevant green building standards such as LEED or Green Building Certification.

nos.title: Apply Health and Safety Practices at the Workplace

performanceCriteria.text: Identify risks and hazards at the workplace.
Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) as per the type of plumbing work.
Place protective barricades and signages around the pits and trenches.
Isolate the plumbing fittings and fixtures from electrical wiring to avoid accidents.
Adhere to organisational procedures for reporting hazards and incidents to relevant authorities.
Establish ventilation before entering underground work areas.
Work safely in and around trenches, elevated places and confined areas.
Ensure tools and hazardous materials are not left unattended.
Ensure good housekeeping in order to prevent hazards, e.g. fire.
Dispose waste materials and used PPE according to regulations and codes of practice.
Follow recommended personal hygiene and sanitation practices, for example washing/sanitizing hands, covering the face with a bent elbow while coughing/sneezing, etc.
Clean and disinfect work area, materials/supplies, equipment, etc. before and after use.
Report hygiene and sanitation issues to the appropriate authority.
Check that the tools, equipment and materials are in good condition and as per industry standards before use.
Use power tools and machinery that are grounded.
Replace or repair split or loose tools before use.
Store and transport various plumbing materials safely.
Follow workplace emergency and evacuation procedures.
Use a fire extinguisher correctly.
Use safe methods to free a person from electrocution.
Administer appropriate first aid (such as CPR etc.) to victims in case of cuts, bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock, poisoning, etc.
Identify employability skills required for jobs in various industries.

Recognize the significance of constitutional values, including civic rights and duties, citizenship and responsibility towards society, and personal values and ethics such as honesty, integrity, caring and respecting others.
Follow environmentally sustainable practices.

Practice the 21st Century Skills such as self-awareness, behaviour skills, time management, critical and adaptive thinking, problem-solving, creative thinking, social and cultural awareness, emotional awareness and learning to learn for continuous learning, in personal and professional life.
Follow verbal and non-verbal communication etiquette and active listening techniques in various settings.
Work collaboratively with others in a team.
Operate digital devices and carry out basic internet operations securely and safely.
Identify different types of customers.
Identify and respond to customer requests and needs in a professional manner.
Create a professional curriculum vitae (resume).

nos.title: Perform Installation of Insulation on Pipes

performanceCriteria.text: Identify different types of insulation materials like fiberglass, mineral wool, foam insulation, cellulose, etc.
Identify different types of covering for the protection of insulation material.
Identify different types of fasteners and joints.
Identify different types of sealing and jointing material.
Identify the accessories such as insulation hanger, insulation saddle, etc.
Identify the different types and grade of pipes.
Identify the different types of measuring devices.
Identify the different types of cutting and sealing devices.
Identify the irregularities in pipe diameter, shape or surface condition and rectify it.
Ensure proper alignment and sealing of insulation joints.
Perform different techniques for cutting such as nesting or pattern cutting to maximize the number of usable pieces from each insulation sheet or roll.
Perform clean and smooth cutting of edges of insulation material to facilitate proper sealing and adhesion during installation.
Avoid ragged or jagged edges.
Identify the correct measurement of material with required instruments.
Calculate the desired thickness of insulation material based on pipe diameter.
Perform checking of thermal conductivity, density and durability.
Perform a tight fit of insulation material around the pipes.
Ensure complete coverage of the pipe, including bends, joints and fittings.
Perform secured sealing of seams, joints and edges of insulation to prevent air leakage and moisture ingress.
Apply fastening methods such as adhesive bonding or mechanical fasteners correctly to ensure insulation stays in place.
Check that insulation should not obstruct access to valves, controls or other components of the piping system.
Check that properly installed insulation effectively reduces heat loss or gain, contributing to energy conservation goals.
Ensure compatibility of insulation material with the operating temperature and conditions of the piping system.
Adhere to safety protocols and regulations, including handling of insulation materials.
Perform the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
Maintain records of insulation installation, including material specifications, measurements and installation procedures.

text.en: Wear the PPE suited to the plumbing task and hazard: helmet, goggles, cut-resistant gloves, gumboots and safety footwear, as per the type of plumbing work (PSC/N0136 PC2).
text.hi: कार्य और खतरे के अनुसार पीपीई पहनें: हेलमेट, गॉगल, कट-रेजिस्टेंट दस्ताने, गमबूट और सुरक्षा जूते (PSC/N0136 PC2)।

text.en: Positive isolation before work: close and lock the water, gas and electrical isolation points that feed the job, drain the line and confirm zero energy before opening any joint.
text.hi: काम शुरू करने से पहले सकारात्मक अलगाव: पानी, गैस और विद्युत आइसोलेशन बंद करके लॉक करें, लाइन खाली करें और कोई जॉइन खोलने से पहले ऊर्जा शून्य की पुष्टि करें।

text.en: Electricity and water mix fatally: isolate plumbing fittings and fixtures from electrical wiring (PSC/N0136 PC4), use grounded power tools only (PC15) and keep hands and floor dry.
text.hi: विद्युत और पानी जानलेवा हो सकते हैं: प्लंबिंग फिटिंग को विद्युत वायरिंग से अलग करें (PSC/N0136 PC4), केवल ग्राउंडेड पावर टूल इस्तेमाल करें (PC15) और हाथ व फर्श सूखे रखें।

text.en: Hot work with a soldering torch: keep LPG/butane cylinders upright and away from the flame, remove combustibles, keep an extinguisher ready and never leave the torch unattended.
text.hi: सोल्डरिंग टॉर्च से हॉट वर्क: एलपीजी/ब्यूटेन सिलेंडर सीधा और लौ से दूर रखें, ज्वलनशील सामग्री हटाएं, अग्निशामक तैयार रखें और टॉर्च बिना देखरेख कभी न छोड़ें।

text.en: Lead-solder fumes: solder only in a ventilated area, avoid breathing the flux fume, never eat or drink at the workstation and wash hands after handling solder.
text.hi: सीसा सोल्डर धुआं: सोल्डरिंग केवल हवादार जगह पर करें, फ्लक्स का धुआं न सांस में लें, कार्यस्थल पर कभी खाएं-पिएं नहीं और सोल्डर छूने के बाद हाथ धोएं।

text.en: PVC solvent cement and adhesives give off flammable, harmful vapour: use them only with cross-ventilation, keep the lid closed after use and away from any flame or spark.
text.hi: पीवीसी सॉल्वेंट सीमेंट और गोंद से ज्वलनशील और हानिकारक वाष्प निकलती है: इन्हें केवल क्रॉस-वेंटिलेशन में उपयोग करें, उपयोग के बाद ढक्कन बंद रखें और लौ/चिंगारी से दूर रखें।

text.en: Confined space / manhole entry: establish ventilation before entering underground work areas (PSC/N0136 PC6), test the air, work with a standby person outside and never enter alone.
text.hi: संकीर्ण स्थान / मैनहोल प्रवेश: भूमिगत क्षेत्र में घुसने से पहले वेंटिलेशन स्थापित करें (PSC/N0136 PC6), हवा की जांच करें, बाहर स्टैंडबाय व्यक्ति रखें और अकेले कभी प्रवेश न करें।

text.en: Place protective barricades and signages around pits and trenches (PSC/N0136 PC3), guard open edges and keep workers and visitors outside the barricaded zone.
text.hi: गड्ढों और खाइयों के चारों ओर सुरक्षात्मक बैरिकेड और साइनेज लगाएं (PSC/N0136 PC3), खुले किनारों की सुरक्षा करें और श्रमिकों व आगंतुकों को बैरिकेड के बाहर रखें।

text.en: Work at height: use stable ladders, scaffolds and elevated platforms only, do not overreach, keep both feet on the rungs and do not work at height alone.
text.hi: ऊंचाई पर काम: केवल स्थिर सीढ़ी, स्कैफोल्ड और ऊंचे मंच का उपयोग करें, झुककर काम न करें, दोनों पैर सीढ़ी पर रखें और अकेले ऊंचाई पर काम न करें।

text.en: Hot-water burns: drain and cool hot water lines before opening them, never open a geyser or solar water heater under pressure, and insulate hot water pipes (PSC/N0142 PC22).
text.hi: गर्म पानी से जलन: गर्म पानी की लाइन खोलने से पहले खाली और ठंडी करें, दबाव में गीजर या सोलर वॉटर हीटर कभी न खोलें, और गर्म पानी के पाइप इंसुलेट करें (PSC/N0142 PC22)।

text.en: LPG/butane cylinder handling: keep cylinders upright and secured, check the hose and regulator for leaks with soap solution, and store cylinders away from heat and work areas.
text.hi: एलपीजी/ब्यूटेन सिलेंडर: सिलेंडर सीधा और बंधा रखें, साबुन के घोल से होज व रेगुलेटर की लीक जांचें और सिलेंडर को गर्मी व कार्य क्षेत्र से दूर रखें।

text.en: Manual handling: lift pipes and fixtures with help or trolleys, bend at the knees, keep the load close to the body and avoid awkward postures to prevent back injury.
text.hi: मैनुअल हैंडलिंग: पाइप और फिटिंग सहायता या ट्रॉली से उठाएं, घुटनों से मुड़ें, भार को शरीर के पास रखें और कमर की चोट से बचने के लिए अजीब मुद्रा से बचें।

text.en: Good housekeeping prevents fire and slips: keep the work area clean and hazard free before and after the job, discard oily rags and flammable materials correctly and store tools safely.
text.hi: साफ-सफाई से आग व फिसलन से बचाव होता है: काम से पहले और बाद में क्षेत्र साफ व खतरा-रहित रखें, चिकने कपड़े व ज्वलनशील सामग्री सही ढंग से निपटाएं और औजार सुरक्षित रखें।

text.en: Waste and cross-contamination: store collected material securely with no spillage, clean and disinfect the work area before and after use, and dispose sewage-contaminated waste per regulations (PSC/N0130 PC18, PSC/N0136 PC10-PC12).
text.hi: अपशिष्ट और क्रॉस-कंटैमिनेशन: इकट्ठी सामग्री सुरक्षित रखें ताकि रिसाव न हो, कार्य क्षेत्र उपयोग से पहले और बाद में साफ व कीटाणुरहित करें, और सीवेज से दूषित अपशिष्ट नियमानुसार निपटाएं।

text.en: Check tools and materials before use: they must be in good condition and as per industry standards; replace or repair split or loose tools, and use only grounded power tools (PSC/N0136 PC14-PC16).
text.hi: उपयोग से पहले औजार व सामग्री जांचें: वे अच्छी स्थिति और उद्योग मानकों के अनुसार हों; फटे या ढीले औजार बदलें या ठीक करें, और केवल ग्राउंडेड पावर टूल उपयोग करें (PSC/N0136 PC14-PC16)।

text.en: Emergency response: follow the workplace emergency and evacuation procedure, use a fire extinguisher correctly, free a casualty from electrocution with safe methods only, and give first aid including CPR for cuts, burns, electric shock or poisoning (PSC/N0136 PC18-PC21).
text.hi: आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया: कार्यस्थल की आपातकालीन व निकासी प्रक्रिया का पालन करें, अग्निशामक का सही उपयोग करें, बिजली के झटके से पीड़ित को केवल सुरक्षित विधि से छुड़ाएं, और कटने, जलन, बिजली झटके या विषाक्तता पर सीपीआर सहित प्राथमिक उपचार दें (PSC/N0136 PC18-PC21)।

prompt.en: As per PSC/N0136, when must a plumber wear personal protective equipment (PPE)?
prompt.hi: PSC/N0136 के अनुसार प्लंबर को निजी सुरक्षा उपकरण (पीपीई) कब पहनना चाहिए?

text.en: Only when the supervisor is watching
As per the type of plumbing work
Only for outdoor work
Only after an accident has happened

explanation.en: PSC/N0136 PC2: wear personal protective equipment (PPE) as per the type of plumbing work - the PPE changes with the hazard.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0136 PC2: प्लंबिंग कार्य के प्रकार के अनुसार निजी सुरक्षा उपकरण (पीपीई) पहनें।

prompt.en: PSC/N0136 PC4 requires the plumber to isolate plumbing fittings and fixtures from what?
prompt.hi: PSC/N0136 PC4 के अनुसार प्लंबर को प्लंबिंग फिटिंग और फिक्स्चर किससे अलग करना चाहिए?

text.en: Electrical wiring
The water supply only
The architectural plan
The neighbouring flat

explanation.en: PSC/N0136 PC4: isolate the plumbing fittings and fixtures from electrical wiring to avoid accidents - water and electricity together cause fatal shocks.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0136 PC4: दुर्घटनाओं से बचने के लिए प्लंबिंग फिटिंग व फिक्स्चर को विद्युत वायरिंग से अलग करें।

prompt.en: What must be placed around pits and trenches as per PSC/N0136 PC3?
prompt.hi: PSC/N0136 PC3 के अनुसार गड्ढों और खाइयों के चारों ओर क्या लगाना चाहिए?

text.en: Plastic sheets only
Protective barricades and signages
Loose bricks at one corner
Nothing, only temporary lighting

explanation.en: PSC/N0136 PC3: place protective barricades and signages around the pits and trenches; PSC/N0130 PC19 extends this to signage and barricades for the whole work area.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0136 PC3: गड्ढों और खाइयों के चारों ओर सुरक्षात्मक बैरिकेड और साइनेज लगाएं।

prompt.en: Before entering underground work areas, PSC/N0136 PC6 requires the plumber to:
prompt.hi: भूमिगत कार्य क्षेत्र में प्रवेश से पहले PSC/N0136 PC6 के अनुसार प्लंबर को क्या करना चाहिए?

text.en: Establish ventilation
Light a candle to test the air
Fill the area with water
Skip the entry if it looks dark

explanation.en: PSC/N0136 PC6: establish ventilation before entering underground work areas. A flame is never a gas test - it can ignite sewer gas.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0136 PC6: भूमिगत कार्य क्षेत्र में प्रवेश से पहले वेंटिलेशन स्थापित करें।

prompt.en: Which statement correctly matches PSC/N0136 PC7?
prompt.hi: PSC/N0136 PC7 से कौन सा कथन सही मेल खाता है?

text.en: Work safely in and around trenches, elevated places and confined areas
Enter confined spaces alone without testing
Work at height without stable access
Leave trench walls unsupported in soft soil

explanation.en: PSC/N0136 PC7: work safely in and around trenches, elevated places and confined areas - these are the highest-risk zones on a plumbing site.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0136 PC7: खाइयों, ऊंचाई और संकीर्ण स्थानों में व उनके आसपास सुरक्षित रूप से काम करें।

prompt.en: PSC/N0136 PC15 on the use of power tools states:
prompt.hi: पावर टूल के उपयोग पर PSC/N0136 PC15 क्या कहता है?

text.en: Use power tools and machinery that are grounded
Remove the earth pin for convenience
Use damaged cables if they are taped
Hold the tool with wet hands for grip

explanation.en: PSC/N0136 PC15: use power tools and machinery that are grounded; PC14 and PC16 add that tools must be in good condition and split or loose tools replaced before use.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0136 PC15: ऐसे पावर टूल और मशीनरी उपयोग करें जो ग्राउंडेड हों।

prompt.en: Which action is required by PSC/N0136 PC19?
prompt.hi: PSC/N0136 PC19 किस कार्य की आवश्यकता रखता है?

text.en: Use a fire extinguisher correctly
Keep extinguishers locked away so they are not stolen
Fight any fire with water
Move burning materials indoors

explanation.en: PSC/N0136 PC19: use a fire extinguisher correctly - right extinguisher for the fire class, kept accessible and never fighting an electrical or solvent fire with water.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0136 PC19: अग्निशामक का सही उपयोग करें - आग के प्रकार के अनुसार सही अग्निशामक लगाएं।

prompt.en: A co-worker is receiving an electric shock. What does PSC/N0136 PC20 require?
prompt.hi: सहकर्मी को बिजली का झटका लग रहा है। PSC/N0136 PC20 क्या निर्देश देता है?

text.en: Pull the person away with bare hands
Use safe methods to free the person from electrocution, starting by isolating the supply
Throw water on the person
Wait for the person to let go on their own

explanation.en: PSC/N0136 PC20: use safe methods to free a person from electrocution - isolate the supply first or push the wire away with a dry non-conducting object; touching the victim with bare hands electrocutes the rescuer too.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0136 PC20: व्यक्ति को विद्युत झटके से सुरक्षित विधि से छुड़ाएं - पहले सप्लाई बंद करें।

prompt.en: PSC/N0136 PC21 requires appropriate first aid (such as CPR) for victims of:
prompt.hi: PSC/N0136 PC21 के अनुसार किन पीड़ितों को सीपीआर सहित उचित प्राथमिक उपचार देना चाहिए?

text.en: Cuts, bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock, poisoning, etc.
Only a minor paper cut
Only heat stroke
Only tiredness after work

explanation.en: PSC/N0136 PC21: administer appropriate first aid (such as CPR etc.) to victims in case of cuts, bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock, poisoning, etc.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0136 PC21: कटने, रक्तस्राव, जलन, घुटन, बिजली झटके, विषाक्तता आदि के पीड़ितों को सीपीआर सहित उचित प्राथमिक उपचार दें।

prompt.en: PSC/N0130 PC19 requires which of the following to protect the work area, workers and visitors?

text.en: Place signages and barricades as required
Keep the area unmarked for faster movement
Store tools in the passage
Allow visitors inside the work zone

explanation.en: PSC/N0130 PC19: place signages and barricades as required to ensure safety and security of the work area, workers and visitors.

prompt.en: Which hand tool is primarily used to grip and turn threaded GI pipes and fittings?

text.en: Pipe wrench (Stilson)
Spirit level
Plunger
Caulking gun

explanation.en: PSC/N0130 KU1 lists pipe wrenches among the hand tools (pipe wrenches, adjustable spanners, pipe cutters, pliers and plungers) used in plumbing.

prompt.en: After cutting a CPVC pipe with a pipe cutter, what must be done before joining it?
prompt.hi: पाइप कटर से सीपीवीसी पाइप काटने के बाद, जोड़ने से पहले क्या करना चाहिए?

text.en: Deburr/ream and clean the cut end
Paint the cut end
Heat the end with a torch
Nothing, the cut is ready to join

explanation.en: PSC/N0130 PC2 covers cutting, deburring/filing, marking and fixing; PSC/N0131 PC9 requires preparing pipe ends by reaming, deburring, levelling, filing and grinding so the joint seals properly.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0130 PC2 कटिंग व डिबरिंग/फाइलिंग और PSC/N0131 PC9 पाइप एंड तैयार करना - रीमिंग, डिबरिंग, फाइलिंग शामिल है।

prompt.en: Which tool is used to clear a blocked drain line that a plunger cannot clear?

text.en: Drain snake / auger
Spirit level
Pipe bender
Pressure gauge

explanation.en: PSC/N0142 PC7 requires unclogging drains and drain strainer baskets; the drain snake/auger (drain cleaning machine in PSC/N0130 KU3) reaches blockages deep in the line that a plunger cannot.

prompt.en: A cup plunger is best suited for:

text.en: Clearing a simple blockage in sinks and WC bowls by creating a pressure surge
Cutting GI pipe to length
Threading a pipe end
Measuring water pressure

explanation.en: PSC/N0130 KU1 lists plungers as basic plumbing hand tools; PSC/N0142 PC7 covers removing blockages - a plunger works on shallow blockages, a drain snake on deeper ones.

prompt.en: Which device is used to check the pressure of a water supply system before commissioning?

text.en: Pressure gauge
Plunger
Hacksaw
Chisel

explanation.en: PSC/N0130 KU5 covers measuring and testing devices such as pressure gauges and leak detectors; PC10 requires the correct pressure and flow rate for the water supply system.

prompt.en: A spirit level is used during installation mainly to:

text.en: Ensure fixtures, supports and pipe runs are level and correctly graded
Cut the pipe to length
Unclog a drain
Measure water pressure

explanation.en: PSC/N0133 PC14 requires plumbing and levelling the supports and fixtures for alignment and balance; PSC/N0130 PC11 requires the correct slope for drainage pipes.

prompt.en: A soldering torch in plumbing is used to:

text.en: Heat soldered joints on copper/GI pipes (hot work)
Cut PVC drainage pipes
Level a wash basin
Detect a hidden leak

explanation.en: PSC/N0130 KU3 lists soldering torches as specialized equipment for plumbing joints. Soldering is hot work: ventilate the area, keep cylinders away from the flame and never leave the torch unattended.

prompt.en: For a drainage system, PSC/N0130 PC11 requires the pipe to be laid with:
prompt.hi: जल निकासी प्रणाली के लिए PSC/N0130 PC11 के अनुसार पाइप किस तरह बिछाना चाहिए?

text.en: The correct size and correct slope (fall)
No slope at all
A slope towards the water supply inlet
The steepest slope possible

explanation.en: PSC/N0130 PC11: ensure correct usage of pipe size and fitting the pipe with correct slope to install the drainage system - too little fall blocks flow, too much fall leaves solids behind.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0130 PC11: सही पाइप साइज और सही ढलान (स्लोप) के साथ ड्रेनेज पाइप बिछाएं।

prompt.en: PSC/N0130 PC14 requires checking the drainage system for proper venting, position of traps and:
prompt.hi: PSC/N0130 PC14 के अनुसार ड्रेनेज प्रणाली में वेंटिंग, ट्रैप की स्थिति के साथ क्या जांचना चाहिए?

text.en: Anti-siphonage to prevent breaking of water seals
Painted covers
Electrical earthing
Solar panel mounting

explanation.en: PSC/N0130 PC14: check the drainage system for proper venting, position of traps and anti-siphonage to prevent breaking of water seals - the water seal stops sewer gas entering the building.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0130 PC14: सही वेंटिंग, ट्रैप की स्थिति और एंटी-सिफोनेज जांचें ताकि वॉटर सील न टूटे।

prompt.en: The correct pipe size/diameter/type for a water supply system is selected to obtain the required:
prompt.hi: जल आपूर्ति प्रणाली के लिए सही पाइप साइज/व्यास/प्रकार किसलिए चुना जाता है?

text.en: Pressure and flow rate
Colour of the water
Noise level of the pipe
Weight of the pipe alone

explanation.en: PSC/N0130 PC10: ensure correct pipe size/diameter/type is used to get the required pressure and flow rate for the water supply system.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0130 PC10: आवश्यक दबाव और प्रवाह दर के लिए सही पाइप साइज/व्यास/प्रकार उपयोग करें।

prompt.en: Which statement best matches PSC/N0131 PC2?
prompt.hi: PSC/N0131 PC2 से कौन सा कथन सर्वोत्तम मेल खाता है?

text.en: The plumber must be able to explain the hot water and cold water distribution/circulation system in detail
One common pipe carries both hot and cold water
Hot water lines are never insulated
Circulation systems are not part of plumbing work

explanation.en: PSC/N0131 PC2: explain in detail the hot water and cold water distribution/circulation system; PSC/N0130 PC7 adds that hot and cold lines are laid correctly and insulated where necessary.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0131 PC2: गर्म और ठंडे पानी की वितरण/परिसंचरण प्रणाली को विस्तार से समझाएं।

prompt.en: A tap yields no water although the supply is on - there is an air lock. PSC/N0142 PC5 requires the plumber to:
prompt.hi: सप्लाई चालू होते हुए भी नल से पानी नहीं आ रहा - एयर लॉक है। PSC/N0142 PC5 के अनुसार प्लंबर क्या करे?

text.en: Remove the air lock and blockages in the pipes
Replace the whole house piping
Increase the pump pressure only
Ignore it, it clears by itself

explanation.en: PSC/N0142 PC5: remove air lock and blockages in the pipes that are installed - air locks are cleared by venting or flushing the line, not by replacing the piping.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0142 PC5: पाइप में एयर लॉक और रुकावट हटाएं - पूरी लाइन बदलने की जरूरत नहीं।

prompt.en: Which of these is a green plumbing practice as per PSC/N0142 PC18-PC24?
prompt.hi: PSC/N0142 PC18-PC24 के अनुसार निम्न में से कौन सी हरित प्लंबिंग प्रथा है?

text.en: Use water-efficient fixtures and apply leak-prevention techniques
Leave taps dripping to keep drains wet
Use high-toxicity solvents for every joint
Oversize pressure so leaks flush away

explanation.en: PSC/N0142 PC18-PC19: minimize water usage with water-efficient fixtures and apply leak-prevention techniques; PC20-PC24 add low-toxicity materials, optimal pressure, hot-water pipe insulation and green building compliance.
explanation.hi: PSC/N0142 PC18-PC19: जल-दक्ष फिटिंग से पानी का उपयोग कम करें और लीक रोकथाम तकनीक अपनाएं।

prompt.en: PSC/N0183 PC15 requires the desired thickness of insulation material to be calculated on the basis of:

text.en: Pipe diameter
Colour of the pipe
Height of the room
Number of taps

explanation.en: PSC/N0183 PC15: calculate the desired thickness of insulation material based on pipe diameter; PC19-PC23 then require sealed seams, correct fastening, access to valves, reduced heat loss and temperature compatibility.

title.en: Safety knowledge check (PPE, isolation, barricades, rescue)
title.hi: सुरक्षा ज्ञान परीक्षण (पीपीई, अलगाव, बैरिकेड, बचाव)

brief.en: Answer the safety questions drawn from PSC/N0136 and PSC/N0130. A failed critical-safety item vetoes the overall pass.
brief.hi: PSC/N0136 और PSC/N0130 से लिए गए सुरक्षा प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें। किसी गंभीर सुरक्षा प्रश्न में असफलता समग्र उत्तीर्णता को रोक देगी।

brief.en: Identify what each plumbing tool does and answer questions on drainage slope, water seals, flow and green practices.
brief.hi: हर प्लंबिंग टूल का कार्य पहचानें और ड्रेनेज ढलान, वॉटर सील, प्रवाह तथा हरित प्रथाओं पर प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें।

title.en: Identify the plumbing hand tools and measuring devices
title.hi: प्लंबिंग हैंड टूल और मापन उपकरण पहचानें

brief.en: From a presented set, pick the hand tools and measuring/inspection devices required for plumbing preparation work and reject the distractors.
brief.hi: दिए गए सेट में से प्लंबिंग तैयारी कार्य के लिए आवश्यक हैंड टूल और मापन/निरीक्षण उपकरण चुनें और भ्रामक विकल्पों को खारिज करें।

title.en: Identify the tools for drainage installation and blockage repair
title.hi: ड्रेनेज इंस्टॉलेशन और रुकावट मरम्मत के औजार पहचानें

brief.en: Pick the correct tools for installing drainage components and for clearing blocked drains and leaking fittings; reject the distractors.
brief.hi: ड्रेनेज कंपोनेंट इंस्टॉल करने और अवरुद्ध ड्रेन व रिसती फिटिंग ठीक करने के सही औजार चुनें; भ्रामक विकल्प खारिज करें।

title.en: Pre-work safety checklist (PPE, isolation, barricades, tool condition)
title.hi: कार्य-पूर्व सुरक्षा चेकलिस्ट (पीपीई, अलगाव, बैरिकेड, औजार की स्थिति)
title.mr: कामापूर्व सुरक्षा यादी (पीपीई, विभक्ती, बॅरिकेड, साधनाची स्थिती)

brief.en: Confirm every isolation, PPE, ventilation, barricading and tool-condition step performed before opening any joint or entering any pit.
brief.hi: कोई भी जॉइन खोलने या गड्ढे में उतरने से पहले किए गए हर अलगाव, पीपीई, वेंटिलेशन, बैरिकेड और औजार-स्थिति चरण की पुष्टि करें।

brief.en: Walk through alignment, levelling, support, fault-rectification and customer handover checks after installing water supply pipework and fixtures.
brief.hi: जल आपूर्ति पाइपलाइन और फिटिंग स्थापित करने के बाद संरेखण, लेवलिंग, सपोर्ट, दोष-सुधार और ग्राहक हैंडओवर जांच करें।

title.en: Photograph the prepared work area (material, barricades, signage, tool check)
title.hi: तैयार कार्य क्षेत्र की फोटो लें (सामग्री, बैरिकेड, साइनेज, टूल जांच)

brief.en: Take photos of the collected material stored without spillage, the cleared work area, the barricades and signages around pits/trenches, and the tools being checked before use.
brief.hi: बिना रिसाव भंडारित सामग्री, साफ कार्य क्षेत्र, गड्ढों/खाइयों के चारों ओर बैरिकेड व साइनेज और उपयोग से पहले औजार जांच की फोटो लें।

title.en: Photograph an installed sanitary fixture (level, supports, connections)
title.hi: स्थापित स्वच्छता फिक्स्चर की फोटो लें (लेवल, सपोर्ट, कनेक्शन)

brief.en: Photograph the installed fixture showing it level and securely fastened, the pipe supports with correct grade and spacing, and the water supply and drainage connections.
brief.hi: ऐसी फोटो लें जिसमें स्थापित फिक्स्चर लेवल व सुरक्षित रूप से जुड़ा हो, पाइप सपोर्ट सही ग्रेड व स्पेसिंग में हों और जल आपूर्ति व ड्रेनेज कनेक्शन दिखें।

title.en: Video: cut, prepare, joint and install a water supply pipe run
title.hi: वीडियो: जल आपूर्ति पाइप काटना, तैयार करना, जोड़ना और इंस्टॉल करना
title.mr: व्हिडिओ: पाणीपुरवठा पाइप कापणे, तयार करणे, जोडणे आणि बसवणे

brief.en: Record the full sequence: measure and mark, cut the GI/CPVC/PPR pipe, deburr the ends, bend to the required offset, join with fittings, install with correct support and alignment, and check the finished run for leaks.
brief.hi: पूरा क्रम रिकॉर्ड करें: नाप व चिह्न, जीआई/सीपीवीसी/पीपीआर पाइप काटना, छोर डिबर करना, आवश्यक ऑफसेट पर मोड़ना, फिटिंग से जोड़ना, सही सपोर्ट व संरेखण के साथ स्थापित करना और लीक की जांच।

title.en: Video: diagnose and repair a domestic plumbing fault
title.hi: वीडियो: घरेलू प्लंबिंग दोष का निदान और मरम्मत

brief.en: Record the diagnosis of the root cause, removal of the blockage/air lock, unclogging of the drain strainer, rectification of the leakage or loose fitting, and the daily maintenance log entry at the end.
brief.hi: मूल कारण का निदान, रुकावट/एयर लॉक हटाना, ड्रेन स्ट्रेनर साफ करना, लीकेज या ढीली फिटिंग ठीक करना और अंत में दैनिक रखरखाव लॉग प्रविष्टि - सब रिकॉर्ड करें।

title.en: Narrate your fault-diagnosis walkthrough of a blocked drain
title.hi: अवरुद्ध ड्रेन के दोष-निदान का वर्णन करें

brief.en: Talk through how you detect the root cause, find the blockage or air lock, unclog the drain and strainer basket, stop the leakage or loose fitting, repair the trap, and record the daily log.
brief.hi: साथ-साथ बताएं कि आप मूल कारण कैसे पहचानते हैं, रुकावट या एयर लॉक कहां मिलाते हैं, ड्रेन व स्ट्रेनर बास्केट कैसे साफ करते हैं, लीकेज या ढीली फिटिंग कैसे रोकते हैं, ट्रैप कैसे ठीक करते हैं और दैनिक लॉग कैसे भरते हैं।

title.en: Narrate the isolation, PPE and emergency-response procedure before starting work
title.hi: काम शुरू करने से पहले अलगाव, पीपीई और आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया प्रक्रिया का वर्णन करें
title.mr: काम सुरू करण्यापूर्वी विभक्ती, पीपीई आणि आणीबाणी प्रतिसाद प्रक्रियेचे वर्णन करा

brief.en: Explain aloud how you identify the hazards, isolate the water/electrical supply, don the correct PPE, barricade the pit or trench, work safely in the confined area, and respond with a fire extinguisher, rescue method and first aid including CPR if something goes wrong.
brief.hi: साथ-साथ बताएं कि आप खतरे कैसे पहचानते हैं, पानी/विद्युत सप्लाई कैसे अलग करते हैं, सही पीपीई कैसे पहनते हैं, गड्ढा या खाई कैसे बैरिकेड करते हैं, संकीर्ण स्थान में सुरक्षित काम कैसे करते हैं, और गलती होने पर अग्निशामक, बचाव विधि तथा सीपीआर सहित प्राथमिक उपचार से कैसे प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं।

levelBands.label: NSQF Level 3 - assists on routine plumbing installation and repair under supervision
NSQF Level 4 - independently installs water supply, drainage and sanitary fixtures
NSQF Level 5 - supervises plumbing works and troubleshoots complex systems

bridgeTraining.skillArea: Safe isolation, PPE and work-area barricading

suggestion.en: Practise the full pre-work sequence until it is habit: identify hazards, isolate the water/electrical supply, don the correct PPE for the task, barricade pits and trenches with signage, and verify every tool is in good condition before use.
suggestion.hi: कार्य-पूर्व पूरी श्रृंखला का अभ्यास करें: खतरे पहचानें, पानी/विद्युत सप्लाई अलग करें, कार्य के अनुसार पीपीई पहनें, गड्ढों-खाइयों पर बैरिकेड व साइनेज लगाएं और उपयोग से पहले हर औजार की जांच करें।

bridgeTraining.skillArea: Drainage venting, traps and correct slope

suggestion.en: Drill on laying drainage pipes with the correct size and slope, positioning traps and inspection chambers, venting and anti-siphonage so water seals never break, and testing the installation for proper functioning.
suggestion.hi: सही साइज व ढलान के साथ ड्रेनेज पाइप बिछाने, ट्रैप व इंस्पेक्शन चैंबर स्थित करने, वेंटिंग व एंटी-सिफोनेज और कार्यशीलता परीक्षण का अभ्यास करें।

bridgeTraining.skillArea: Pipe cutting, deburring, bending and jointing

suggestion.en: Repeat measure-mark-cut-deburr-bend-join on GI, CPVC and PPR pipe until every cut end is reamed smooth, every bend hits the specified angle and every joint meets the required specification.

bridgeTraining.skillArea: Fault finding: blockages, air lock and leakages

suggestion.en: Build speed at detecting the root cause of low flow, blockages and air locks, unclogging drains and strainer baskets, and resolving leakages, loosening and jamming of fittings - then record the daily log.
suggestion.hi: कम प्रवाह, रुकावट और एयर लॉक का मूल कारण पहचानने, ड्रेन व स्ट्रेनर साफ करने और लीकेज/जाम हल करने में गति बढ़ाएं - अंत में दैनिक लॉग भरें।

bridgeTraining.skillArea: Confined space, hot work and emergency response

suggestion.en: Rehearse ventilation and standby cover before manhole or underground entry, safe LPG torch and solvent-cement handling, fire extinguisher selection, safe freeing from electrocution, and first aid including CPR.
suggestion.hi: मैनहोल/भूमिगत प्रवेश से पहले वेंटिलेशन व स्टैंडबाय, सुरक्षित टॉर्च व सॉल्वेंट हैंडलिंग, अग्निशामक चयन, विद्युत झटके से बचाव और सीपीआर सहित प्राथमिक उपचार का अभ्यास करें।
